title: fix(plugin-detail): the record highlights strip draws a boolean as one neutral chip
body:
domain:ui#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaJoinvGQSbHeDaWBe
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg4i9JiKjEjwtuVzd4gKy9hB)_

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么：记录页顶部的「亮点条」（record:highlights）里，布尔字段不再是「是=绿、否=琥珀」两种颜色，统一画成一个中性的小标签，只显示「是 / 否」字样。
- 为什么改：HotCRM 发现「SLA 已违约：否」被画成警告色，其实「否」才是好事；元数据并没有说哪个值是好的，详情区本来就只画一个中性的词，亮点条应与它一致。
- 风险与回滚：只改一个渲染分支的样式类，不动数据和元数据；回滚即还原这一个提交。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/HeaderHighlight.tsx` 布尔分支；`HeaderHighlight.booleanNeutral-27434.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/HeaderHighlight.booleanNeutral-27434.test.tsx`，预期 3 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #27434

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

Card #27434 lists seven gaps HotCRM measured on 18.2.0. Each row was re-measured on `main` at e41642dd. This PR takes row 4; the other rows are answered below, and the rows that need a new key, a spec change or a change outside `ui/` go to cards of their own, now filed by the seat: #27944 (row 2), #27945 (row 3), #27946 (row 5), #27947 (row 6) and #27948 (rows 7 and 1). With every row taken or carded, this PR closes the card.

**Row 4 (taken).** `HeaderHighlight` drew a boolean `true` as an emerald "✓ Yes" chip and `false` as an amber "× No" chip, whatever the field means. Both values now share one neutral chip (`bg-muted`, `text-foreground`, `ring-border`), carrying the locale's Yes / No word from `useBooleanValueLabel` and no glyph. That matches the details body, which draws the same read-only field as the plain word. The now-unused `Check` and `X` icon imports are dropped. A field-level key that says which value is the bad one is not invented here: that is a spec question (see Acceptance notes).

| Row | Bucket | Reading on `main` |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Already done; the residual joins row 7 | The row reaches the dialog from both doors. The record header (`page:header` `dispatchHeaderAction`) and a list row's menu (`objectGridActionsColumn`) both stash it under `params._rowRecord`. Both param-collection handlers seed `defaultFromRow` from it (by the param's `field`, else its `name`). The runner's `interpolate` fills `${record.x}` in `description` and `helpText` on both doors (objectui#12967, shipped in 18.0.0). What prints raw is a `{{ record.x }}` hole. Measured through the runner: `Email {{ record.display_name }} / ${record.display_name}` reads `Email {{ record.display_name }} / Acme` from both doors. That is the hole-syntax split of row 7. |
| 2 | Card (spec + ui) | No action key names the dialog's submit verb; the footer reads `actionDialog.confirm`. |
| 3 | Card (spec + form) | A form has no lookup-pick autofill. The only one is the line-item grid column's `autofill`, which copies same-named fields and exists only in that grid. |
| 4 | Taken here | See above. |
| 5 | Card (spec) | `ActionSchema` has no per-reader `active` / `pressed` predicate. |
| 6 | Card (server) | `resolveRef` in the import runner (`@objectstack/core`) still tries `id`, `displayField`, the title field, then `name`/`title`/`label`/`full_name`/`email`/`username`. It never tries the target's `unique` fields. |
| 7 | Card (spec + runtime), with row 1's residual | `composeSuccessMessage` fills `outcomeMessages` through `substituteScopeTokens` (`${result.x}`), and `successMessage` through `fillTemplateHoles` (`{{ }}`). The param dialog's `description` and `helpText` read `${…}` through the evaluator. `confirmText` reads `{{ }}`, and the spec tells an author with params to move the confirm question onto `description`, where the same `{{ record.x }}` hole stops filling. |

## Tests

- New `HeaderHighlight.booleanNeutral-27434.test.tsx` (3 cases): neither chip carries a state colour class or a glyph; the `true` and `false` chips share one class list and differ only by the word; a control that the strip drew its non-boolean value.
- Ablation, run twice against the committed fix and restored from `HEAD` each time (`git hash-object` matched the HEAD blob after both):
  - The file restored to `origin/main`: 2 of 3 cases red.
  - Through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, `rounded-full bg-muted px-2` replaced by `rounded-full bg-amber-500/10 px-2` (anchor 1 to 0, blob changed): case 1 red.
- Every `plugin-detail` highlights, record page and summary-chip test file (22 files; `HeaderHighlight.booleanLocale-11689` included): 21 passed, 1 skipped, 177 tests passed.
- `@object-ui/plugin-detail` `type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- Row 4's "a field-level key saying which value is the bad one" is the spec half of that row. It is not built here; the neutral default is what the details body already does.
- Out of scope, for the seat to file as cards: rows 2, 3, 5 and 6, and row 7 together with row 1's `{{ }}` residual. Titles, bodies, landing sites and dedupe words are in the os-dev report on #27434.
- No i18n string changed: the chip reads the existing `useBooleanValueLabel` words.

## Verification

Each command was run on 189ad8a2, with its exit code captured before any pipe. The derived gate list was reconciled with `dispatch-gates --ran`; the full list is in the report on #27434.
